name: bodyweight b stance good morning
description: A hip hinge with one foot staggered slightly behind. It biases one leg to train the hamstrings and glutes and builds balance.
instructions: Stand with one foot flat and the other slightly behind, toe resting on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the front leg.
Return to standing and switch legs after your set.
